name: Space-Based Architecture
forces_resolved: Elimination of the central database as a runtime bottleneck via in-memory replicated data grids
Sub-10ms read and write latency at massive concurrency
Extreme elasticity and auto-scaling processing units
forces_unresolved: Extremely high RAM hosting costs for distributed in-memory data caches
Complex cache replication and synchronization collision management
Eventual asynchronous writes to persistent storage risk data loss during abrupt cluster dropouts
applicability_conditions: High-frequency algorithmic trading, online gaming leaderboards, ticketing surges
Workloads with extreme variable traffic spikes and strict sub-20ms SLA
Sufficient cloud budget to sustain large multi-node memory clusters
anti_requisites: Small engineering team without dedicated cluster operations specialists
Strict immediate synchronous relational durability requirements
